capabilities: Display tasks from vault notes in a date-based timeline view
Filter tasks by date, priority, tag, path, and status with counters
Add new tasks to an inbox or chosen note from the quick entry panel
Read dates in Tasks emoji format or Dataview field format
Open a task's note and edit it through the Tasks plugin's edit modal
disambiguation: Not a standalone calendar or task manager; it is a wrapper around Obsidian-Tasks-Calendar and Obsidian-Tasks-Timeline that adds settings pages and update support.
extras: The README points users to Tasks Timeline, a rebuilt continuation available in community plugins; this wrapper still receives bug fixes. Development is supported via optional donations (Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, PayPal, Patreon). An ExampleVault with screenshots is referenced.
intentEvidence: This plugin provides setting pages and update support for 702573N's great work
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that organizes tasks from across the vault by due, scheduled, and start dates in one timeline.
